outline.subject: HMS Warrior was a light aircraft carrier that served in the British Royal Navy, the Royal Canadian Navy, and the Argentine Navy.

sections.title: HMS Warrior ( R31 )
sections.covers: This section provides an overview of the ship's construction, its service history under different navies, and its eventual disposal.

sections.title: Description
sections.covers: This section details the physical specifications, propulsion systems, armament, and design features of the aircraft carrier.

sections.title: Construction and career
sections.covers: This section describes the ship's building process and its period of service with the Royal Canadian Navy.

sections.title: Royal Navy service
sections.covers: This section outlines the ship's refits, experimental trials, and operational deployments while serving in the British Royal Navy.

sections.title: Argentine Navy service
sections.covers: This section covers the ship's acquisition, modifications, and final years of service with the Argentine Navy.
